name: components/watermark
description: A page-level watermark overlay for enterprise anti-screenshot scenarios. Renders repeated text or image marks across a container with configurable spacing, rotation, offset, layer order, and typography.
useCases: Display user identity or session metadata as a repeated page watermark
Mark internal dashboards and analytics pages as confidential
Overlay tenant name or environment label in multi-tenant enterprise systems
Apply custom image-based security marks on sensitive operation pages
